tagline: Locally Owned and Operated Lawn Care Services

why_choose_us.title: Locally owned and operated
why_choose_us.description: Dan and his crew live in the same valley you do. We are not a national franchise routing your call to a center three states away.

why_choose_us.title: 25+ years on Northeast PA lawns
why_choose_us.description: We have been treating the shale soil, short seasons, and grub pressure specific to this region since the 1990s.

why_choose_us.title: A program built for your lawn
why_choose_us.description: We soil test first. Your grass type, your watering, your soil pH — the program follows the lawn, not a one-size sales sheet.

why_choose_us.title: Organic options on request
why_choose_us.description: If you would rather keep it natural, we run slow-release organic programs that feed the soil biology instead of just the grass.

services_section.subtitle: Fertilization, weed and pest control, aeration, and soil correction across Lackawanna, Luzerne, and Wyoming counties.
